alternatives.argument: The local proof expands the unbiased sample variance of independent full-set estimates and identifies the variance of their mean directly.
The local proof combines the independent replicate CLT, almost-sure sample-variance consistency and Slutsky’s theorem with AC stated explicitly.
The carrier defines the shared independent base-b digit shifts pointwise and distinguishes their dependence structure from nested scrambling.
The carrier defines the prefix-indexed permutation array and output digits, with explicit randomization inputs.
The carrier proves the finite-prefix digit translation is bijective, then derives marginal uniformity and net-count preservation.
The carrier proves each output prefix is uniform by induction and shows every prefix map permutes the input prefix classes.
The carrier computes the child-contrast covariance, sums finite ANOVA terms, and passes to the L2 limit using Parseval.
The carrier groups the finite ordered-pair covariance sum by shared-prefix depth and derives the alternating pair-count formula.
The carrier combines the local smooth ANOVA coefficient estimate, gain bound and convergent scale sum to obtain the rate.
